Anuj Shukla vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 April, 2025
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: Anuj Shukla vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 11141 of 2025

Applicant :- Anuj Shukla
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Satyakam Dubey,Suneel Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.
Heard Sri Sunil Kr. Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant, Ms. Hariyali Sharma, opposite party No.2 in person and Sri Sandeep Chaudhary, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant application has been filed to quash the entire proceeding of Case No. 1851 of 2020,
arising out of case crime No. 44 of 2019, u/s 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.
Shahganj, District Prayagraj, as well as charge sheet dated 23.7.2020 and summoning order dated 17.12.2020.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature and both the parties have settled their dispute amicably and entered into a written compromise dated 17.3.2025.
It is further submitted that the aforesaid compromise has already been filed before the court below.
4. Though opposite party No.2, in person, did not dispute the above fact, learned AGA states that the impugned proceeding cannot be quashed until the aforesaid compromise is verified.

5. In view of the above, the court below is directed to verify the said compromise after summoning the parties within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and after Anuj Shukla vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168100579/
1 verification, the court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding in accordance with law.

entities.text: Anuj Shukla vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. For a period of one month or till verification of compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant in the aforesaid case.
7. However, the parties are at liberty to file a fresh application under Section 528 BNSS to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified copy of compromise, if need arises.
8. With the aforesaid direction, the present application is disposed of.

Order Date :- 7.4.2025 Vandana  Anuj Shukla vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168100579/
